key_catalyst: Alphabet's raised AI capex guidance to $195-205B triggering a 4%+ after-hours decline and questioning hyperscaler spending ROI
reasoning: Multiple bearish catalysts are converging and escalating rather than resolving: Alphabet's raised capex guidance ($195-205B) triggered a 4%+ after-hours drop in a top-QQQ holding, directly souring the AI-spending thesis, while oil topping $95 (Iran rejecting talks, Red Sea blockade) is driving a hawkish Fed repricing (September hike odds surging to ~83%) and pushing the 30-year yield above 5%. Unlike 2026-07-22 when SMCI/AMD deal optimism offset oil and yield pressure, today the mega-cap earnings reaction is itself the new negative catalyst with no bullish counterweight, and the -1.58% pre-market print shows the market is actively repricing risk lower rather than absorbing it.
